title: A staged Braiding-Readiness Evidence Ledger study for a candidate Majorana topological-qubit primitive

research_brief.scientific_object: A proposed gate-defined network of proximitized semiconductor-superconductor islands containing a candidate Majorana sector.
research_brief.central_hypothesis: A controllable topological Majorana sector yields a coherent multi-axis pattern across phase, nonlocality, protocol-order-dependent operation, protection scaling, and architectural resource accounting that matched trivial controls cannot reproduce.
falsification_conditions: matched trivial control meets the same composite criterion
order-reversal control is indistinguishable from proposed exchange protocol
remote perturbation lacks predicted nonlocal effect
protection trend fails or is explained by local covariates
universal-computation budget has no viable non-Clifford path

prohibited_actions: no claim of observed Majorana, braiding, or qubit result

stages.name: Pre-registration and digital-twin falsification map
stages.purpose: Freeze the discriminating signatures, nuisance ranges, control protocols, analysis code specification, and decision boundaries before future device data are viewed.
inputs: parameter priors supplied by a qualified device team
stages.gate: No physical data interpretation begins until candidate and null model families, endpoint definitions, and correction method are predeclared.

stages.name: Phase and reproducibility screening
stages.purpose: Test whether a declared candidate region and excitation-gap proxy recur across device batches and are distinguishable from intentionally trivial controls.
stages.gate: Advance only if the preregistered phase criterion and cross-device reproducibility criterion both pass; otherwise classify as phase candidate not supported.

stages.name: Nonlocality and parity-structure tests
stages.purpose: Determine whether paired-end/readout behavior contains remote, parity-constrained information that a fitted local null model cannot explain.
stages.gate: Advance only if held-out device and intentionally local control results reject the declared local-null envelope at the predeclared uncertainty threshold.

stages.name: Fusion/exchange order-dependence test
stages.purpose: Compare predeclared protocol orders with matched pulse, timing, and readout controls to test the predicted order-sensitive transformation.
stages.gate: Advance only if the target order contrast is reproducible across predeclared devices, remains after blinded analysis, and is not reproduced by the matched trivial control.

stages.name: Protection and architecture translation
stages.purpose: Estimate whether the encoded operation improves a relevant error proxy with design variables and whether the resulting primitive has a quantitative universal-computation route.
stages.gate: Classify as braiding-ready only if protection scaling survives alternative models and the universal resource budget passes a predeclared feasibility condition.

endpoints.primary: Conjunctive BREL classification: pass only when each of phase, nonlocality, operation, protection, and architecture columns meets its preregistered threshold against its matched control.
secondary: effect sizes and uncertainty for every column
endpoints.negative_results: A null or partial result is an informative classification, not a failed study: it identifies the earliest unsupported causal link.

principles: analyze full distributions rather than selected favorable traces
separate exploratory diagnostics from confirmatory endpoints
report effect sizes and compatible intervals
use hierarchical device/batch models when adequate data exist
perform sensitivity analyses for reasonable nuisance models
analysis_plan.candidate_model: A compact effective topological model with a declared phase boundary and nonlocal parity predictions.
analysis_plan.decision_rule: A target classification needs all predeclared column gates. Failure in any target column blocks a stronger claim and triggers the corresponding diagnostic or redesign review.

data_governance: immutable raw-data archive under laboratory policy
separation of exploratory and confirmatory analysis
reproduction: repeat target protocols across independent device batches
hold out at least one batch before threshold setting is finalized
share non-sensitive analysis specification and summary-level evidence when institutional/IP rules permit

risks_and_human_review.risk: False-positive topology claim from a local mimic
risks_and_human_review.mitigation: matched trivial controls, nonlocal endpoint, multiple null models, and conjunctive gate.
independent calibration references, recovery diagnostics, and explicit inconclusive state rather than forced classification.

risks_and_human_review.risk: Selection bias across many device traces
risks_and_human_review.mitigation: preregistered inclusion, blinding, distribution-level reporting, and hold-out devices.

risks_and_human_review.risk: Overclaiming fault tolerance from a physical signal
risks_and_human_review.mitigation: separate phase, operation, protection, and universal-computation claims in all outputs.

risks_and_human_review.risk: Cryogenic/electrical laboratory hazards and equipment constraints
risks_and_human_review.mitigation: the present design does not execute hardware work; any future work is performed only by qualified laboratory personnel under local safety, equipment, and institutional procedures.
